As a result, the industry is moving optical interfaces closer to CPUs and GPUs, from the front-panel transceiver to the package itself through co-packaged optics (CPO), and eventually directly into the processor package. Optical connectivity has been used for decades, as electrical links cannot efficiently and reliably transmit data over long distances at high data transfer rates.
